paper_title: InfEHR: clinical phenotype resolution via deep geometric learning on electronic health records
prediction_task: Binary classification of neonatal culture-negative sepsis (CN-S) and postoperative acute kidney injury (PO-AKI) from whole EHR using deep geometric learning (GNN)

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: CN-S cohort lacks external validation; performance reported only on training data initially, no separate held-out validation described for CN-S.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Performed stratified 80/20 train/test split on CN-S by birth weight; acknowledged lack of external CN-S validation as limitation in discussion.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Cohort definition unclear: missing baseline characteristics table, no accounting of patients excluded during preprocessing, positive rates for CN-S and PO-AKI not reported.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added baseline demographic tables for both cohorts with train/validation splits; documented exclusion counts (CN-S retained n=5213 excluded n=2854; PO-AKI retained n=4276 excluded n=3764).

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: No benchmarking against comparable deep learning time-series models (GRU-D, SeFT, Life2Vec) - limits ability to judge whether geometric GNN choice is justified.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Implemented GRU-D and SeFT benchmarks on UCIMC dataset; reported results in Table 2. Life2Vec excluded due to feature incompatibility (socioeconomic data unavailable).

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Reliance on ICD/diagnosis codes for label generation avoided, but weakly-labeled propagation (MAP@1 0.71-0.79) raises questions about noisy labels cascading into downstream training.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Justified medium-density regime per Ratner et al. data programming theory; authors argue imperfect labels are acceptable in weak supervision and GNN denoises. Avoided diagnosis codes due to post-hoc application timing.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Chosen hyperparameters (embedding dimensions, pooling ratio) not stated in manuscript, limiting reproducibility of the GNN tuning.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added explicit hyperparameter section: input dim d=160, pool ratio 0.8, hidden dims H1=256/H2=128, output d=128 representation + d=2 classifier.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Handling of unstructured clinical narratives unclear: NLP pipeline for free-text extraction not described; ontology standardization (SNOMED/UMLS) not specified.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Documented QuickUMLS extraction + TF-IDF + NMF topic filtering pipeline for note-derived nodes; acknowledged temporality/semantics limitations and noted SNOMED-CT integration as future work.
